mechanism_assessment.interpretation: If the fixed common second-hop input retains window error above 1e-4 while first-hop and aperture-crop errors are smaller, first-hop window variation alone cannot explain G3. A valid nonperiodic integral can compare each window with the stated sampled-field reference, but this diagnostic does not force a separate causal label for frequency-grid sampling and periodic-boundary interaction.

independent_cpu_reference.definition: CPU complex128 composite four-point Gauss-Legendre evaluation of the nonperiodic bandlimited sampled-field angular-spectrum integral over the fixed Nyquist square; no pixel sinc factor, extra filter, or spatial-grid expansion

claim_limits: fiber coordinates and MFD remain unmeasured simulation assumptions
the CPU integral represents the explicitly defined nonperiodic bandlimited sampled field, not a measured continuous aperture
a nonconverged independent quadrature cannot support error-source attribution
small edge power alone does not rule out periodic boundary interaction
no OLS channel-count or capacity conclusion is made in this task
